function.name: search_products
function.description: Search for products based on various criteria such as color, size, category, price range, and brand, to find specific Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) or general Stock Production Units (SPUs). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

color.description: The color of the product. This is an optional parameter that can be used to refine SKU searches.

size.description: The size of the product. This is an optional parameter that can be used to refine SKU searches.

category.description: The category of the product, such as 'electronics', 'clothing', or 'furniture'. This parameter is required for both SPU and SKU level searches.

price_min.description: The minimum price of the product search. Enter a float value representing the lowest price in dollars. This is a float type value.

price_max.description: The maximum price of the product search. Enter a float value representing the highest price in dollars. This is a float type value.

brand.description: The brand of the product. This is an optional parameter for searching within a specific brand.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific product, including options for size, color, material, and care instructions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item_id.description: The unique identifier of the product, required to fetch specific product details.

color.description: The color of the product. Specify this parameter to filter product details by color.

size.description: The size of the product. Specify this parameter to filter product details by size.

detailLevel.description: The level of detail required for the product information. Use 'SKU' for size and color details.

material.description: The material of the product. This parameter is optional and can be used to filter product details.

care_instructions.description: Whether to include care instructions in the product details. If true, care instructions will be included.

We need to search for product category maybe "skirt" or "rok" with color shimmer? The function search_products requires category. We can guess category "clothing" or "skirts". Let's use category "clothing" and maybe brand? Not known. We can search for "shimmer skirt" maybe color "shimmer" or "shimmering". But we don't have a brand. Let's search with category "clothing" and maybe color "shimmer" or "shimmering". But color param expects a color string. "shimmer" might not be a color. Maybe we can search with category "clothing" and brand unspecified. We can also search with size "XL" to filter. Let's do search_products with category "clothing", size "XL". That will return SKUs. Then we can check if any product has "shimmer" in name. But we can't parse results. We can just call search_products with category "clothing" and size "XL". Then we can ask user to confirm.
